Price, L., Worrell, E., Martin, N., Lehman, B. and Sinton, J. (2000). China's Industrial Sector in an International Context. Report LBNL-46273, Ernest Orlando Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, May 2000. No DOI printed.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 2 to + 3 for the front matter; the tables used are on printed pp. 5, 8, 11, 13). A sector-comparison paper: China versus OECD countries for steel, aluminium, cement, refining, ammonia and ethylene, almost all at the level of national averages and (in Table 5) primary energy. The only technology-level numbers are cement specific energy for rotary vs vertical shaft kilns (Table 3, 1990) and ammonia energy by plant size (Table 4, 1981-1990, loaded for 1990). Both are loaded in the main file with fuel-and-electricity target because the paper does not say what the energy basis is, but Table 5 repeats the China values under a "primary energy" heading, so they are probably primary energy; mapping is low confidence so the coordinator can leave them out. Steel (35.6 GJ/t 1991), aluminium electricity (Table 2, incl. Canada 17.9 MWh/t) and the Table 5 summary are in other-values. Not loaded: figures read from charts, refining, ethylene, production statistics. No money values.
